extraction.Name: Benjamin Beauvais
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, but later I had it sent back to Washington when Mr. McGregor was Superintendent here. I think it was about 1924.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: there must have been about $200 tax still against the land; since I owed some taxes on the land I could not have the patent cancelled
extraction.NOTES: Received patent by mail at Mission, South Dakota; did not request patent; sent patent back to Washington circa 1924 when Mr. McGregor was Superintendent; told he could not have patent cancelled because he owed taxes on the land; sold land for $3200 with approximately $200 tax against it; purchaser paid cash with no debts settled at time of sale; has seven children; in good health; did not like the patent because it was sent without his asking for it; document number E-484; notarized April 15, 1929 by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32
